description: Read the payout ledger for the functions you own on the marketplace: what each call earned, its commission and its payout status. Filter by payout_status and page with limit and offset. Read-only. Needs a Last Price credential with billing read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

limit.description: How many to return. Defaults to 50.

offset.description: How many to skip, for the next page.

payout_status.description: Only entries with this payout status.

name: get_marketplace_earnings
